title: Golden re-bless ships opaque hash churn with no in-chunk justification or audit trail
detail: Chunk contains only hash churn; the catalog/sim change that produced 17d3baf8c6e1df7f is not shown, so an enshrined regression is indistinguishable from intended behavior by review.
recommended_fix: Land the triggering change with the re-bless in one reviewable PR; have the blessing tool emit a per-demo state-diff summary so reviewers verify substance, not hashes.

title: Tick-1 hashes diverge in every demo, including demos unrelated to the apparent feature
location: goldens/boot.t1:tick 1 (recurs in all 12 files, e.g. forecast_shift, audio_throttle, ecmp)
detail: All 12 demos change from tick 1 — boot, audio_throttle, ecmp, forecast_shift included. Either catalog_hash is mixed into every tick hash, or a cross-cutting behavior change occurred; confirm which.
recommended_fix: Verify tick-hash derivation intentionally folds in catalog_hash; if it does not, this re-bless is masking a global behavior change requiring investigation before merge.

title: Cannot confirm every golden in the repo was re-blessed
detail: This chunk updates 12 .t1 files off catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860; any golden outside the chunk still carrying the old hash will mismatch (or be silently skipped) after merge.
recommended_fix: After merge, grep the repo for 66c4324a06058860; ensure the blessing command regenerates the entire golden set rather than a hand-picked subset.
